m_c389fcef6d97.en: Image, PDF, ZIP, QR, Markdown, color, unit conversion, text comparison and OCR processing happen in your browser. ZIP contents are checked and extracted locally; archive files are never uploaded. Password Generator uses cryptographic randomness and does not save, log or upload generated passwords. Copying a password places it on your device clipboard. Images, PDF files, QR content, Wi-Fi passwords and logos are not uploaded or saved to your workspace. QR appearance presets contain only colors and size. OCR downloads only the language packs you choose, and caches them in your browser. Existing text tools send text to cloud storage only when you explicitly save a signed-in draft. Answer Book and Decision Studio automatically save new or edited records: locally first, then privately to your signed-in account. Answer Book questions are never saved. Guest history is not automatically uploaded when you sign in.
m_c389fcef6d97.zh-Hant: 圖片、PDF、ZIP、QR、Markdown、色彩、單位換算、文字比較及 OCR 都在瀏覽器中處理。ZIP 內容在本機檢查與解壓縮，壓縮包不會上傳。Password Generator 使用密碼學安全隨機數，不會儲存、記錄或上傳產生的密碼。複製密碼會將它放入裝置的剪貼簿。圖片、PDF 檔案、QR 內容、Wi-Fi 密碼及 Logo 不會上傳或儲存至工作區。QR 外觀預設只包含色彩與尺寸。OCR 只下載你選擇的語言包，並快取在瀏覽器中。既有文字工具只會在你明確儲存已登入的草稿時，將文字傳至雲端。Answer Book 和 Decision Studio 會自動儲存新增或編輯的記錄：先存於本機，再私下同步至已登入的帳號。答案之書的問題不會儲存。登入時不會自動上傳訪客歷史。

m_73be239704e9.en: Network Test is an online measurement, started only by you. Your browser downloads and uploads synthetic test data directly to Cloudflare, which receives your connection IP and handles requests under its own privacy policy. A Full Test schedules 488.9 MB of payload at most; all attempts including retries share a 500 MB payload budget, with protocol overhead additional. Extra per-measurement and final-result reporting are disabled. The test stops when cancelled, hidden, left or timed out. The last 20 completed results, valid sample curves, connection organization and approximate region are stored only in this browser and can be deleted or cleared; they are never synced to your account. A small Cloudflare /meta request runs once after Start for connection details. Full IP is masked by default, exists only on the current page and is excluded from history, logs and every report. Exported PNG/CSV/JSON reports exclude full IP. Old summary-only history remains readable. Measurements describe your connection to Cloudflare, not every internet destination.
m_73be239704e9.zh-Hant: Network Test 是由你主動啟動的線上測量。瀏覽器會直接向 Cloudflare 下載及上傳合成測試資料；Cloudflare 會取得連線 IP，並依其隱私政策處理請求。完整測試最多排定 488.9 MB 的測試負載；所有嘗試及重試共用 500 MB 的負載上限，通訊協定開銷另計。額外的逐次測量及最終結果上報均已關閉。取消、頁面隱藏、離開或逾時都會停止測試。最近 20 次完成結果、有效樣本曲線、連線組織及概略地區只儲存在此瀏覽器，可個別刪除或全部清除，不會同步至帳號。按下開始後，會向 Cloudflare /meta 發送一次小型請求以取得連線資訊。完整 IP 預設遮蔽，只存在目前頁面，不會加入歷史、記錄或任何報告。匯出的 PNG／CSV／JSON 報告也不包含完整 IP。只有摘要的舊歷史仍可讀取。測量反映你至 Cloudflare 的連線，不代表所有網路目的地。

m_b9b7d9a9be72.en: Time Studio uses your device clock and browser time-zone data. Clock settings and named countdowns stay on this device; it does not provide background alarms. File Renamer downloads renamed ZIP copies without changing originals. Audio files, waveform samples, exported audio, JSON and CSV inputs are processed locally. Audio is never saved or uploaded. JSON and CSV are not uploaded; optional text recovery can retain selected editor text on this device when enabled. MP3 encoding runs locally using a vendored encoder and WASM. CSV downloads escape spreadsheet formula cells and explain any escaping.
m_b9b7d9a9be72.zh-Hant: Time Studio 使用裝置時鐘與瀏覽器時區資料。時鐘設定及命名倒數只保留在此裝置，不提供背景鬧鈴。File Renamer 下載重新命名的 ZIP 副本，不會更動原始檔。音訊檔案、波形樣本、匯出音訊，以及 JSON 與 CSV 輸入都在本機處理。音訊不會儲存或上傳。JSON 與 CSV 不會上傳；開啟選用文字恢復後，可將指定編輯器中的文字保留在裝置上。MP3 使用本站提供的編碼器與 WASM 在本機編碼。CSV 下載會對試算表公式儲存格進行跳脫處理，並說明這些處理。

m_eadeb058796e.zh-Hant: 學習卡與本機實用工具

m_bb27d9bf620c.en: Learning cards and review mastery are stored in IndexedDB on this device. Signed-in card decks sync privately to your account; guest decks are not automatically uploaded. Private decks are excluded from public profiles. Conflicts retain copies, and deleted cloud decks keep empty synchronization tombstones. Calculator history stays on this device. File checksums, subtitle files and local preview videos are processed here without uploads. Download subtitle edits before leaving. PDF information cleanup covers the standard Info dictionary and document/page XMP only.
m_bb27d9bf620c.zh-Hant: 學習卡及複習熟練度儲存在此裝置的 IndexedDB。登入後，牌組會私下同步至帳號，訪客牌組不會自動上傳。私人牌組不會出現在公開個人檔案。衝突時會保留副本；已刪除的雲端牌組會留下不含內容的同步刪除標記。計算機歷史只保留在此裝置。檔案校驗碼、字幕檔及本機預覽影片都在這裡處理，不會上傳。離開前請下載字幕修改。PDF 資訊清理僅涵蓋標準 Info 字典及文件／頁面的 XMP。

m_9826a60715fc.en: Plans and vector whiteboards save first in IndexedDB and sync privately when signed in. Guest records are copied to an account only through Copy to account. Sync queues are isolated by account; conflicting edits retain a copy. Whiteboards do not embed files or external pages. Workspace provides deletion and backups.
m_9826a60715fc.zh-Hant: 計畫及向量白板先儲存至 IndexedDB，登入後再私下同步。訪客記錄只會透過「複製至帳號」操作匯入帳號。同步佇列依帳號隔離；編輯衝突時保留副本。白板不嵌入檔案或外部頁面。工作區提供刪除與備份功能。

m_b842801aaeb3.en: Screen recording, microphone recording and QR scanning start only after your action and device permission. Camera frames, scanned content and recordings stay on this page, are never uploaded or added to history, and must be downloaded to keep. Stopping or leaving releases capture devices. Screen recording continues when switching windows. Shared audio and recording formats depend on your browser. QR links open only when you choose.
m_b842801aaeb3.zh-Hant: 錄屏、麥克風錄音及 QR 掃描，都只會在你主動操作並授予裝置權限後開始。相機影格、掃描內容和錄製結果只保留在此頁面，不會上傳或加入歷史；若要保留，必須自行下載。停止或離開會釋放擷取裝置。切換視窗時錄屏會繼續。能否分享音訊及錄製格式取決於瀏覽器。QR 連結只會在你選擇時開啟。

m_8c0cb0619ed3.en: Favorites, presets, saved drafts, timer settings and completed focus sessions are stored in this browser. Clearing browser storage removes local data. Use the workspace export to keep a backup.
m_8c0cb0619ed3.zh-Hant: 收藏、預設、草稿、計時器設定及已完成的專注回合，都儲存在此瀏覽器。清除瀏覽器儲存空間會移除本機資料。請使用工作區匯出功能保留備份。

m_a56ae821d870.en: When configured, Google sign-in is provided through Supabase. Account identity and private items are stored with Supabase, with access limited to your account. Your Google display name and avatar initialize your public profile on first sign-in. Existing chosen names and later profile edits are retained. Profile names, avatars and biographies are public; your email and tool histories stay private. The application requests basic profile and email information, not access to your Google files.
m_a56ae821d870.zh-Hant: 設定完成後，Google 登入由 Supabase 提供。帳號身分及私人項目儲存在 Supabase，存取權限僅限你的帳號。首次登入會以 Google 顯示名稱和頭像建立公開個人檔案；原先選擇的名稱及之後的修改都會保留。個人檔案名稱、頭像與簡介為公開資料；電子郵件及工具歷史仍為私人資料。應用程式只要求基本個人資料及電子郵件資訊，不會存取你的 Google 檔案。

m_ff4d397f9197.en: Typing Practice scores stay in this browser. Ranked sends your completed input to Supabase to calculate a score; raw typed text is not retained. Public is the default typing mode and requires sign-in; Practice remains local and can be selected without an account. Qualifying best scores publish your current public name, speed, accuracy and date, with a link to your public profile. Uploaded avatars are the only images sent to profile storage, after you explicitly save them; file-tool inputs are never uploaded. Avatars are center-cropped and re-encoded in the browser, then stored publicly in Supabase Storage. Google avatars may be loaded from Google, and can be replaced or removed in Profile. English and Chinese use separate versioned boards. Device tests run only when started, stop when you leave their test area, and never save or upload key or mouse events.
m_ff4d397f9197.zh-Hant: 打字練習成績只保留在此瀏覽器。排名測試會將完成的輸入傳至 Supabase 計算分數，不保留原始輸入文字。打字預設為公開模式，需要登入；練習仍在本機進行，無須帳號即可選擇。合格的最佳成績會公開目前的名稱、速度、準確率和日期，並連結至公開個人檔案。只有在你明確儲存後，上傳的頭像才會傳至個人檔案儲存空間；檔案工具的輸入不會上傳。頭像會在瀏覽器中置中裁切並重新編碼，再公開儲存在 Supabase Storage。Google 頭像可能從 Google 載入，並可在個人檔案中更換或移除。英文和中文使用不同版本的排行榜。裝置測試只在啟動後執行，離開測試區域即停止，且不儲存或上傳鍵盤及滑鼠事件。

m_2b3919360505.en: Remember on this device is off by default and enabled separately for each supported tool and account. It stores only selected editor text and settings in IndexedDB on this browser, with up to three recent editing sessions and 2 MB per copy. Restore or discard dated copies explicitly. Recovery is separate from Workspace saves and is never automatically synced. Passwords, QR and Wi-Fi content, Answer Book questions, typing input, file objects and media are excluded. Turning recovery off clears this tool’s copies for the current identity. Existing private autosave records keep their original behavior.
m_2b3919360505.zh-Hant: 「記住此裝置」預設關閉，並依支援的工具與帳號分別啟用。它只將指定的編輯器文字與設定儲存於此瀏覽器的 IndexedDB，最多保留最近三次編輯工作階段，每份上限為 2 MB。請明確選擇恢復或捨棄附有日期的副本。恢復副本與工作區儲存分開，不會自動同步。密碼、QR 與 Wi-Fi 內容、答案之書問題、打字輸入、檔案物件及媒體都不包含在內。關閉恢復會清除目前身分在此工具的恢復副本。既有私人自動儲存記錄保留原有行為。

m_093db0bc3125.en: Private game progress and personal bests save on this device. Signed-in account saves sync privately to Supabase, isolated from guest saves. Guest saves copy to an account only when requested. New signed-in games that support rankings automatically submit eligible completed results. Guests can play without signing in; old local results are not uploaded to rankings. Connect Four and Reversi are local-only matches. Their computer opponents run in a browser worker, and local two-player matches use the same device. Public runs send a versioned action replay to Supabase for verification and publish your current profile name, avatar, result and date. Replays are not public and are not retained after verification. Paused, hidden or restored games continue privately and cannot enter the board. Pending completed submissions stay on this device for retry, isolated by account. Leaderboards are casual and cannot prevent automated play. Game saves can be deleted in Games. Sound defaults to 35% and starts only after a game gesture; mute, volume and Effects preferences remain on this device. Brick Breaker current and Previous rules rankings are separate; legacy saves and results are retained. Profile pages include qualifying game bests and unlocked milestone badges with dates. Only server-verified Public results count toward the 30 milestones and personal progress; locked milestone progress is visible only to its owner. Historical badges use only provable results.
m_093db0bc3125.zh-Hant: 私人遊戲進度和個人最佳儲存在此裝置。已登入的帳號存檔會私下同步至 Supabase，與訪客存檔隔離。訪客存檔只在明確要求時複製至帳號。登入後，支援排名的新遊戲會自動提交合格的完成結果。訪客無須登入即可遊玩；舊本機成績不會上傳至排行榜。四子棋與黑白棋只在本機對局；電腦對手在瀏覽器 Worker 中執行，本機雙人則共用同一裝置。公開對局會將附版本的操作重播傳至 Supabase 驗證，並公開目前的個人檔案名稱、頭像、成績及日期。重播不公開，且驗證後不保留。暫停、頁面隱藏或從存檔恢復的遊戲會以私人方式繼續，不能進入排行榜。已完成但待提交的結果依帳號隔離，保留在此裝置供重試。排行榜屬休閒性質，無法防止自動遊玩。可在 Games 刪除存檔。音量預設為 35%，只在遊戲操作後啟用；靜音、音量與效果偏好只保留在此裝置。Brick Breaker 的目前規則與舊規則排行榜分開，舊存檔及成績保留。個人檔案包含合格的遊戲最佳成績，以及附解鎖日期的里程碑徽章。只有經伺服器驗證的公開成績會計入 30 項里程碑及個人進度；尚未解鎖的進度僅本人可見。歷史徽章只根據可證明的結果補發。

m_eeb4a20f6eed.en: Pong requires both players to sign in. Room members see each other’s public profile name and avatar. Positions and game controls travel through private Supabase Realtime channels, not per-frame database writes. Only short-lived room lifecycle and membership are stored. Rooms have two players, waiting rooms expire after 15 minutes, and pauses expire after 60 seconds. Pong does not create public rankings, achievements, permanent match records or resumable saves. Leaving, account changes and expired rooms release the connection. Supabase handles connection metadata under its own privacy policy.
m_eeb4a20f6eed.zh-Hant: Pong 需要雙方登入。房間成員可看到彼此公開個人檔案的名稱與頭像。位置與遊戲控制透過 Supabase Realtime 私人頻道傳送，不會逐影格寫入資料庫。系統只儲存短期的房間生命週期及成員資料。每個房間限兩位玩家；等候房間在 15 分鐘後失效，暫停在 60 秒後逾期。Pong 不建立公開排名、成就、永久對局記錄或可續玩的存檔。離開、切換帳號及房間到期時都會釋放連線。Supabase 依其隱私政策處理連線中繼資料。

m_e5b07ea4b667.en: Delete or clear private histories in Workspace, export each history, or sign out. Autosave caches and retry queues are isolated by account. Conflicting scheme edits are kept as separate copies. Deleted cloud records retain an empty-content tombstone for sync; minimal retry receipts contain no saved record content. Signing out hides account data on this device. The platform does not add advertising trackers.
m_e5b07ea4b667.zh-Hant: 你可以在工作區刪除或清空私人歷史、匯出各項歷史，或登出。自動儲存快取及重試佇列依帳號隔離；方案編輯衝突會另存副本。已刪除的雲端記錄會留下不含內容的同步刪除標記；最小化的重試回執不含已儲存的內容。登出會隱藏此裝置上的帳號資料。平台不加入廣告追蹤器。

m_a896beff76f9.en: About Me, 3A3D, GitHub and Pixiv are independent websites with their own privacy policies.
m_a896beff76f9.zh-Hant: About Me、3A3D、GitHub 與 Pixiv 是獨立網站，各有自己的隱私政策。

m_55c9687565da.en: A name, a little personality, and your next best score.
m_55c9687565da.zh-Hant: 一個名字、一點個性，還有下一次最佳成績。

m_7547896770bb.zh-Hant: 讓這個空間展現你的風格。

m_7f2fb2e1a4f9.en: Sign in with Google to edit your name, avatar and biography.
m_7f2fb2e1a4f9.zh-Hant: 使用 Google 登入，即可編輯名稱、頭像與簡介。

m_e26f36b0c7f9.en: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to 5 MB. Center-cropped to a square. Uploaded when you save.
m_e26f36b0c7f9.zh-Hant: JPG、PNG 或 WebP · 上限 5 MB。置中裁切為正方形，按下儲存後才會上傳。

m_d7ba8df8b162.en: 2–32 characters. Your Google name is used initially; you can choose another unique name.
m_d7ba8df8b162.zh-Hant: 2–32 個字元。首次使用 Google 名稱，之後可選擇其他不重複的名稱。

m_0018b8955e9f.en: Your name, avatar, biography and qualifying best typing and game scores are public. Your email, drafts and tool histories stay private.
m_0018b8955e9f.zh-Hant: 名稱、頭像、簡介，以及合格的打字與遊戲最佳成績為公開資料。電子郵件、草稿與工具歷史仍為私人資料。

m_78572688dfce.en: THE PERSON BEHIND THE PERSONAL BESTS

m_0c869719d6c1.zh-Hant: 款遊戲擁有排名最佳成績

m_f26a582596f5.en: Verified Public results, grouped by game and difficulty. Each score is a personal best for its current rules.
m_f26a582596f5.zh-Hant: 依遊戲與難度整理的已驗證公開成績。每項成績都是目前規則下的個人最佳。

m_f2db3bf573a5.en: Unlocked through qualifying Public results. Private play and unfinished runs stay outside these records.
m_f2db3bf573a5.zh-Hant: 透過合格公開成績解鎖。私人遊玩和未完成對局不計入這些記錄。

m_6f701003fa56.en: Only qualifying Public bests appear here. Private games, saves and practice sessions stay private.
m_6f701003fa56.zh-Hant: 這裡只顯示合格的公開最佳成績。私人遊戲、存檔與練習仍保持私人。

m_5bffff12a562.en: Websites, software and creative experiments. Each one starts with a little curiosity.
m_5bffff12a562.zh-Hant: 網站、軟體與創意實驗，每一個都從一點好奇開始。

m_8f5c80053876.en: An automotive showcase built around car culture, visual discovery and detailed specifications.
m_8f5c80053876.zh-Hant: 以汽車文化、視覺探索及詳細規格為核心的汽車展示網站。

m_2d76c199f4a5.en: A C++ coursework project exploring how software can support salon operations.
m_2d76c199f4a5.zh-Hant: 探索軟體如何支援沙龍營運的 C++ 課程專案。

m_73f4390975e7.zh-Hant: 生成式探索 · 圖形封面

m_2970188a1ae7.en: A collection of visual experiments with local AI and image generation.
m_2970188a1ae7.zh-Hant: 運用本機 AI 和影像生成進行的視覺實驗集。

m_47173482314e.en: Pick up where you left off
m_47173482314e.zh-Hant: 從上次停下的地方繼續

m_a81b80d40643.en: Your favorites, saved words and moments of focus.
m_a81b80d40643.zh-Hant: 收藏、儲存的文字與專注時刻。

m_f370027ae18f.en: Local saves work now. Connect your account to sync between devices.
m_f370027ae18f.zh-Hant: 現在即可在本機儲存。連結帳號，便能跨裝置同步。

m_36926029ed47.en: Car imagery from the existing project. This cover is a graphic composition, not a screenshot.
m_36926029ed47.zh-Hant: 車輛影像來自原有專案。此封面是圖形構圖，並非畫面截圖。

m_51311166442f.en: 3A3D brings automotive browsing into a visual, editorial experience. The project combines a shared design system with a structured vehicle catalog.
m_51311166442f.zh-Hant: 3A3D 將汽車瀏覽帶入兼具視覺與編輯設計的體驗，以共用設計系統搭配結構化車輛目錄。

m_1d701f6da5b0.zh-Hant: 可重複使用的範本及目錄資料

m_f423f2601a9f.en: HTML, CSS, JavaScript and a Python static-page generator.
m_f423f2601a9f.zh-Hant: HTML、CSS、JavaScript 及 Python 靜態頁面產生器。

m_7ef69f8d1f77.en: Part of an ongoing collection of projects and experiments.
m_7ef69f8d1f77.zh-Hant: 持續累積的作品與實驗之一。

m_d3ac1f07b180.en: Abstract graphic cover. Browse Pixiv to see the actual artworks.
m_d3ac1f07b180.zh-Hant: 抽象圖形封面。請前往 Pixiv 欣賞實際作品。

m_f86567eff5ee.en: A space for exploring image generation, composition and visual direction. The artwork collection lives on Pixiv as a separate creative destination.
m_f86567eff5ee.zh-Hant: 探索影像生成、構圖與視覺方向的空間。作品集在 Pixiv 獨立展示。

m_030d865edab1.en: Local AI and digital image creation.
m_030d865edab1.zh-Hant: 本機 AI 與數位影像創作。

m_aebc2d3bfe69.en: Illustrative cover. The code graphic is not a screenshot of the application.
m_aebc2d3bfe69.zh-Hant: 示意封面。程式碼圖形並非應用程式的畫面截圖。

m_90cebf2fe07d.en: An exploration of C++ and system design through a salon management application. The repository is the source of truth for implementation details.
m_90cebf2fe07d.zh-Hant: 透過沙龍管理應用程式探索 C++ 與系統設計。實作細節以儲存庫中的原始碼為準。

m_103c05628e6e.en: Salon operations as a software domain
m_103c05628e6e.zh-Hant: 以沙龍營運為軟體領域

m_22764558fe10.zh-Hant: 課程原始碼可在 GitHub 查看

m_9ae9992ba6dc.en: C++. Explore the source for implementation and assignment context.
m_9ae9992ba6dc.zh-Hant: C++。請探索原始碼，了解實作與作業背景。

m_72b33c672792.en: Your language preference is stored on this device. Public site search uses a static index of tools, games and projects and does not search private records.
m_72b33c672792.zh-Hant: 語言偏好儲存在此裝置。全站搜尋使用工具、遊戲與作品的靜態公開索引，不會搜尋私人記錄。
